deviations.source_anchor: The your-hits-only-feed-a-pet-that-does-everything identity lands via PROXY_ASCENSION/PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY + the Virulence accumulator + two skill-entries (crawler proxy + Cyclone feeder), but the specific coupling -- the Agony Crawler's attack-speed/damage scaling CONTINUOUSLY off the live Virulence count, and the crawler DYING the instant Virulence hits 0 -- is a behavioral property of the accumulator noted in economy rather than a bespoke 'stack-count-drives-proxy-power-and-lifespan' primitive. geometry_bands.source_anchor: summons an Agony Crawler minion (proxy) that uses projectile and area attacks and does ALL the killing; its attack speed and damage scale off the player's Virulence stack count (max 40); the crawler DIES if Virulence hits 0. totem = the autonomous placed proxy; shadow (chaos) family + poison (the damage register). The proxy is the entire offense

the player spins with Cyclone (or Caustic Arrow) purely to POISON enemies rapidly; each poison inflicted grants a Virulence stack that feeds the crawler. whirlwind = the Cyclone spin; the player's hits do ~no killing, they only build virulence. Ball Lightning is a common secondary poison-applier

mapping.deviation_notes: The your-hits-only-feed-a-pet-that-does-everything identity lands via PROXY_ASCENSION/PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY + the Virulence accumulator + two skill-entries (crawler proxy + Cyclone feeder), but the specific coupling -- the Agony Crawler's attack-speed/damage scaling CONTINUOUSLY off the live Virulence count, and the crawler DYING the instant Virulence hits 0 -- is a behavioral property of the accumulator noted in economy rather than a bespoke 'stack-count-drives-proxy-power-and-lifespan' primitive. A player keeps the feed-the-scorpion identity; the exact stack-to-proxy-power curve and the death-at-empty failure state are abstracted.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PROXY-FEEDER build -- PROXY_ASCENSION (the summoner archetype where a proxy does the killing) + PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY (a single dominant super-proxy, the Agony Crawler, whose power scales with the feed). shadow (chaos) family + poison (crosswalk s1: chaos-poison -> shadow, ailment poison; s2 stack-additive native). TWO skill-entries: the crawler proxy (totem, the offense) + the player's Cyclone feeder (whirlwind, pure virulence-generation). THE IDENTITY = 'your hits do nothing but feed Virulence stacks to a scorpion pet that does everything, and the pet dies without the feed'. Virulence -> charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator (build via poison-applications, decays, crawler-power scales off the count, 0=death). The Golden Rule (self-poison feeds virulence too) is an economy accelerant. PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY captures the single-super-minion-fed-by-player-actions structure; the 'proxy DIES if the stack empties' dependency is a behavioral property of the accumulator noted in economy. Cyclone-feeder = whirlwind geometry (the player's actual input). Clean proxy-feeder map.
mapping_json.motion_frame: proxy-feeder: the player's only job is to spin through the pack applying poisons that stack Virulence; the Agony Crawler pet does 100% of the actual killing and lives only as long as Virulence is fed

economy: Virulence accumulator (max 40 stacks; poison-applications build it, decay drops it, 0 = crawler dies)
The Golden Rule (self-poison also feeds Virulence, doubling stack rate)
